title: BodyToggle
description: A toggle of a body's model (a mesh, or a "Hide X" shape key of a mesh) and whether it is shown (since 1.5), as the renderer sets it.

mesh.description: The mesh's name in the model.

key.description: The shape key, null for the mesh itself.

hides.description: Whether the key at full weight hides the part (it is shown at 0); false for a mesh.
